messages:
Sam: Hey team — opened a small change that tweaks the attention kernel tiling heuristic to avoid a perf cliff on long-context streaming. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4216
Rachel: on it, linking perf run
Devin: pinging @Rachel and @Marta for kernels/benchmark sanity
InfraBot: CI started for PR #4216 — linux-ox1, tests/ci-inference
Marta: quick skim — looks fine but can you add a tiny unit test for dynamic tile size? else lgtm
Sam: added test in latest commit, pushed
Oliver: ran perf locally, no regressions on 8k sequences; slight mem spike at 32k but within limit
Devin: can you post the perf numbers? curious about per-token latency
Oliver: micro numbers: baseline 12.2ms/token → patch 11.8ms/token at batch=1; at batch=8 3.9ms → 3.6ms
Rachel: thanks — can we also check KV cache evictions? this change touches compute tiling but might interact with KV prefetching
Sam: good call. I added a config flag to keep kv_prefetch=true for the tests. snippet:
```yaml
runtime:
  kernel_tiling: auto
  kv_prefetch: true
```
Marta: ok that's safer
InfraBot: CI passed for PR #4216 — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Devin: I'm happy to approve once you fix the small lint in utils/tiling.py (flake8 error)
Sam: fixed lint, squashed
Rachel: approving now :thumbsup:
Marta: approving as well
Oliver: will coordinate a light canary deploy if you want to roll tonight
Sam: thanks all — aiming to merge at 21:00 PT if no other concerns. canary for 2h then full rollout
Devin: noted, will watch traces and cost dashboards
Rachel: thanks, merging when CI is green again
InfraBot: Merge completed for PR #4216 by Sam at 1782004099
Sam: thanks everyone :pray:
